seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Monroe, NC: the rescheduled downtown tree lighting and Santa and the Grinchy guest at the Main Library.
lede: Monroe celebrates Christmas in its historic downtown, where the City of Monroe runs the Christmas Parade, a tree lighting and a Santa's Workshop.
celebrates: The City of Monroe has taken over the downtown Christmas Parade, the 73rd, which stepped off on Sunday, November 22. The city's calendar then moves to a rescheduled tree lighting on Saturday, December 5, from 5:30 to 6 pm, after weather forced a postponement, and lists a Santa's Workshop experience from December 5 to 21. The Union County Public Library brings Santa and a Grinchy guest to the Main Library on Windsor Street on December 7, in the Children's Room, one of a series of branch visits.
lastyear: In December 2024 the City of Monroe ran Santa's Workshop for the second year in the former Union County Community Arts Council building at 120 North Main Street. The city's news post said it was free for all ages, open Thursdays and Fridays from 6 to 9 pm and Saturdays from 4 to 8 pm, and that guests could tour the workshop, see Santa's friends and meet Santa. Professional photos were not available, so families took their own.
facts: The Monroe Christmas Parade runs through historic downtown Monroe, and the city's participant page says entry fees are free for schools. The tree lighting was first moved from December 5 to November 21 to share a weekend with the parade, then cancelled for weather and set again for December 5. The Union County library system closes all branches December 23 through 26, and the Main Library sits at 316 E. Windsor Street.
trains: Monroe has no Christmas train ride of its own on our pages. The closest holiday train in our Charlotte guide is THE POLAR EXPRESS train ride at the N.C. Transportation Museum in Spencer, which is a longer drive from Union County. For a Christmas story near home, the Union County Main Library's Santa and Grinchy guest visit on December 7 and the downtown Santa's Workshop are the family options on our page.
train_links: The museum in Spencer runs THE POLAR EXPRESS train ride in the Christmas season and is listed in our Charlotte guide.

faq: When is the Monroe tree lighting in 2026?

The City of Monroe rescheduled its Christmas Tree Lighting to Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 5:30 to 6 pm in Downtown Monroe after weather forced a postponement of the November 21 date. The city's listing does not print a price. Questions can go to the city at 704-282-4500.
Where can kids meet Santa in Monroe?

The Union County Main Library hosts Santa and a Grinchy guest on Monday, December 7, from 5:30 to 6:30 pm in the Children's Room at 316 E. Windsor Street. The City of Monroe's calendar also lists a Santa's Workshop from December 5 to 21, though its hours were not posted when we checked.
Was the Monroe Christmas Parade in 2026?

Yes, the 73rd Monroe Christmas Parade stepped off on Sunday, November 22, 2026, at 2 pm in historic downtown, so it has passed. The City of Monroe now runs the parade. Upcoming dates on this page start with the December 5 tree lighting.
Is there a train ride near Monroe?

Monroe has no train ride on our pages. The N.C. Transportation Museum in Spencer runs THE POLAR EXPRESS train ride and is the nearest holiday train in our Charlotte guide. Check the museum's own site for dates and tickets, since schedules and prices change by date.
